epics.name: Navigate Bot Behavior
epics.notes: Epic covers all panel-level features for the BotBehavior webview — behavior tree navigation, instructions display, and execution settings.

context_source.description: Panel HTML template defines the panel's surface area

sub_epics.name: Display Instructions
sub_epics.notes: Sub-epic covers loading and displaying instructions for the selected behavior and action in the panel. Domain-level loading (loadBehaviors/loadActions) is already implemented; this sub-epic focuses on surfacing that data in the panel UI.

context_source.description: User request: add stories for displaying and loading instructions for selected behaviors and actions

story_groups.notes: Behavior instructions display and action instructions display are related panel stories — both write to the same instructions-panel DOM element, triggered by different user selections.

context_source.description: navigateToBehavior() and renderTree() are the primary interaction points for behavior selection

acceptance_criteria.name: WHEN user clicks behavior-item in behavior tree THEN instructions-panel renders behavior's instructions as instruction-item list AND currentBehavior span updates to selected behavior name
acceptance_criteria.text: WHEN user clicks behavior-item in behavior tree THEN instructions-panel renders behavior's instructions as instruction-item list AND currentBehavior span updates to selected behavior name

acceptance_criteria.name: WHEN selected behavior has empty instructions array THEN instructions-panel displays instructions-empty placeholder text BUT does not render instruction-item elements
acceptance_criteria.text: WHEN selected behavior has empty instructions array THEN instructions-panel displays instructions-empty placeholder text BUT does not render instruction-item elements

acceptance_criteria.name: WHEN navigateToBehavior completes THEN _postCurrentState sends message including behaviorInstructions array AND client updateInstructionsPanel renders each item from behaviorInstructions into instructions-panel
acceptance_criteria.text: WHEN navigateToBehavior completes THEN _postCurrentState sends message including behaviorInstructions array AND client updateInstructionsPanel renders each item from behaviorInstructions into instructions-panel

acceptance_criteria.name: WHEN panel initializes with current behavior set THEN instructions-panel populates from BotBehaviorHydrateData with currentBehavior instructions array AND instructions-panel reflects config-loaded instructions
acceptance_criteria.text: WHEN panel initializes with current behavior set THEN instructions-panel populates from BotBehaviorHydrateData with currentBehavior instructions array AND instructions-panel reflects config-loaded instructions

acceptance_criteria.name: WHEN user selects different behavior THEN instructions-panel clears previous behavior instructions AND renders new behavior instructions BUT does not mix instructions from different behaviors
acceptance_criteria.text: WHEN user selects different behavior THEN instructions-panel clears previous behavior instructions AND renders new behavior instructions BUT does not mix instructions from different behaviors

acceptance_criteria.text: WHEN behavior has multiple instructions THEN instructions-panel displays all instruction strings in their original config order AND each string is a separate instruction-item element

scenarios.name: BotBehavior renders and completes behavior instructions display when user selects behavior
background: Given BotBehavior panel is open with behaviors loaded from BotBehaviorHydrateData
And instructions-panel is present in panel DOM

context_source.description: navigateToBehavior() is the primary client method triggered by behavior-name click

scenarios.steps:
Given BotBehavior has 'shape' behavior loaded with instructions ['Shape the story map']
When user selects 'shape' behavior in behavior tree
Then instructions-panel contains one instruction-item element
And instruction-item text is 'Shape the story map'
And currentBehavior span text is 'shape'

scenarios.name: BotBehavior shows empty state when selected behavior has no instructions
background: Given BotBehavior panel is open with behaviors loaded from BotBehaviorHydrateData
And instructions-panel is present in panel DOM

context_source.basis: AC #2 — empty instructions array must show placeholder, not blank area

scenarios.steps:
Given BotBehavior has 'empty-behavior' behavior loaded with instructions []
When user selects 'empty-behavior' behavior in behavior tree
Then instructions-panel contains instructions-empty placeholder
And instructions-panel contains zero instruction-item elements

scenarios.name: BotBehavior replaces prior behavior instructions when user selects different behavior
background: Given BotBehavior panel is open with behaviors loaded from BotBehaviorHydrateData
And instructions-panel is present in panel DOM

context_source.basis: AC #5 — switching behaviors must clear old instructions and render new ones

scenarios.steps:
Given BotBehavior has 'shape' and 'prioritization' behaviors loaded
And 'shape' behavior is currently selected showing its instructions
When user selects 'prioritization' behavior in behavior tree
Then instructions-panel contains instruction-item elements for 'prioritization' instructions
And instructions-panel contains no instruction-item elements from 'shape' instructions

scenarios.name: BotBehavior populates instructions-panel from BotBehaviorHydrateData on panel init
background: Given BotBehavior panel DOM is loaded with empty instructions-panel
And BotBehaviorHydrateData message is available with allowedBehaviors and behaviorConfigs

context_source.description: hydrate() calls super.loadBehaviors() + loadActions() when allowedBehaviors present in message — this is the panel init path

scenarios.steps:
Given BotBehaviorHydrateData contains allowedBehaviors ['shape'] and behaviorConfigs with 'shape' having instructions ['Shape the story map']
When panel receives BotBehaviorHydrateData init message
Then instructions-panel contains one instruction-item with text 'Shape the story map'
And currentBehavior span text is 'shape'

scenarios.name: BotBehavior displays multiple behavior instructions in config order
background: Given BotBehavior panel is open with behaviors loaded from BotBehaviorHydrateData
And instructions-panel is present in panel DOM

context_source.basis: AC #6 — multiple instructions must all appear as separate items in original order

scenarios.steps:
Given BotBehavior has 'multi-behavior' behavior loaded with instructions ['First instruction', 'Second instruction', 'Third instruction']
When user selects 'multi-behavior' behavior in behavior tree
Then instructions-panel contains three instruction-item elements
And first instruction-item text is 'First instruction'
And second instruction-item text is 'Second instruction'
And third instruction-item text is 'Third instruction'

context_source.description: loadActions() merges base instructions first then behavior-specific instructions — this is the merged array displayed

acceptance_criteria.text: WHEN user clicks action-item in behavior tree THEN instructions-panel renders action's merged instructions as instruction-item list AND currentAction span updates to selected action name

acceptance_criteria.text: WHEN selected action has empty merged instructions array THEN instructions-panel displays instructions-empty placeholder text BUT does not retain previous action's instruction-item elements

scenarios.name: BotBehavior renders and completes merged action instructions display when user selects action
background: Given BotBehavior panel is open with behaviors and actions loaded from BotBehaviorHydrateData
And instructions-panel is present in panel DOM

context_source.description: navigateToAction() is triggered by action-item click; action.instructions is already merged by loadActions()

scenarios.steps:
Given BotBehavior has 'shape' behavior with 'clarify' action loaded
And 'clarify' action has merged instructions from IBaseActionConfig and IBehaviorConfig workflow entry
When user selects 'clarify' action in behavior tree
Then instructions-panel contains instruction-item elements for each merged instruction
And instruction-item elements appear in merged order: base instructions first, then behavior-specific
And currentAction span text is 'clarify'

scenarios.name: BotBehavior shows empty state when selected action has no merged instructions
background: Given BotBehavior panel is open with behaviors and actions loaded from BotBehaviorHydrateData
And instructions-panel is present in panel DOM

context_source.description: strategy action has empty behavior instructions []; base has instructions — combined is non-empty. Need a fully empty case.

scenarios.steps:
Given BotBehavior has 'shape' behavior with an action that has empty base instructions and empty behavior instructions
When user selects that action in behavior tree
Then instructions-panel contains instructions-empty placeholder
And instructions-panel contains zero instruction-item elements

scenarios.name: BotBehavior replaces prior action instructions when user navigates to different action
background: Given BotBehavior panel is open with behaviors and actions loaded from BotBehaviorHydrateData
And instructions-panel is present in panel DOM

context_source.basis: AC #4 — Next/Back navigation must fully replace instructions, no prior content retained

scenarios.steps:
Given BotBehavior is at 'shape' behavior with 'clarify' action selected showing its instructions
When user presses Next button to advance to 'strategy' action
Then instructions-panel contains instruction-item elements for 'strategy' action instructions
And instructions-panel contains no instruction-item elements from 'clarify' action
And currentAction span text is 'strategy'

scenarios.name: BotBehavior shows base instructions first then behavior-specific instructions in merged order
background: Given BotBehavior panel is open with behaviors and actions loaded from BotBehaviorHydrateData
And instructions-panel is present in panel DOM

context_source.description: loadActions() merges: base instructions first, then workflow entry instructions — this is the key domain merge rule

scenarios.steps:
Given BotBehavior has 'shape' behavior with 'clarify' action
And IBaseActionConfig for 'clarify' has instructions ['IMPORTANT: Follow these action instructions specifically', 'Review all provided context']
And 'shape' behavior workflow entry for 'clarify' has instructions ['Gather context for story mapping']
When user selects 'clarify' action in behavior tree
Then first instruction-item text is 'IMPORTANT: Follow these action instructions specifically'
And second instruction-item text is 'Review all provided context'
And third instruction-item text is 'Gather context for story mapping'
And instructions-panel contains exactly three instruction-item elements

scenarios.name: BotBehavior populates action instructions from BotBehaviorHydrateData on panel init
background: Given BotBehavior panel DOM is loaded with empty instructions-panel
And BotBehaviorHydrateData message is available with allowedBehaviors, behaviorConfigs, and baseActionConfigs

context_source.description: hydrate() with allowedBehaviors calls super.loadBehaviors()+loadActions() — current action instructions are set at init

scenarios.steps:
Given BotBehaviorHydrateData contains allowedBehaviors, behaviorConfigs with 'shape', and baseActionConfigs for 'clarify'
When panel receives BotBehaviorHydrateData init message
Then instructions-panel contains instruction-item elements for the current action's merged instructions
And currentAction span text matches the first action in 'shape' behavior workflow
